Yes, HCA Healthcare, Inc. announced a change to its dividend policy in the annual report. Specifically, during 2022, the Board of Directors declared four quarterly dividends of $0.56 per share, totaling $2.24 per share for the year. Then, on January 26, 2023, the Board declared a quarterly dividend of $0.60 per share payable on March 31, 2023. This indicates an increase in the quarterly dividend from $0.56 to $0.60 per share starting in 2023. The declaration, amount, and timing of dividends remain subject to the Board's discretion based on capital availability and other factors [S1, S2, S3, S4].
